ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: When a lotus leaf moves without wind, fish are certainly passing below. Chan masters use this physical inference as an answer or verdict: an unexplained visible disturbance licenses naming an unseen active cause, without turning the fish into a symbolic code.
EvidenceBody: Yunwai Xingze answers ‘when it is sealed tight, what then?’ with the full saying and strikes when the questioner asks again. Tianyin uses it as his second of three phrases, Feiyin answers a question about Yantou's confidential disclosure with it, and Wanru closes a public question about his preceding verse with the same inference.
